name: Depend!
source:
Ordinary days and incidents... and completely unordinary ones! 
From part-time work to school commute to bathtub... peeping!? 
Depend! is a wacky spring love "day to day" romance ADV where day to day is almost unbelievable!

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE093667.html]DLsite English[/url]]
